name: Poached Chicken Salad with Goat Cheese, Avocado & Pistachios
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.

Place chicken, salt, and pepper in a large pot and cover with water by 1-inch; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board trim and medium dice celery; place in a medium bowl.
Zest lemons into the bowl with the celery.
Roughly chop pistachios; add to the bowl along with yogurt and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Juice the lemons into a large bowl. Add oil and whisk to combine the dressing.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Using two forks, shred chicken and add to the bowl with the yogurt mixture. Mix well to combine.
To serve, place salad greens on a plate and top with chicken salad, sliced avocado, and crumbled goat cheese. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
